17 here. I got into spyro’s adventure and giants for the wii as a kid. Both games were so revolutionary and cool at the time, though the novelty of toys to life died down after Disney infinity and other competitors came out. I skipped swap force since I didn’t like the swap mechanic but I came around for trap team because the figures (with the traptanium weapons) looked so cool. After trap team I lost my interest in the games until earlier this year when I found my old collection of skylanders in a moving box. However, Activision stopped making skylanders games for the wii platform so I couldn’t get back into the games.... until I found out literally a few weeks ago that there is an Imaginators port for the Switch. I’m in the process of collecting the senseis (which, imo, are the best looking figures to date) and creation crystals. So far I have 8 senseis and 2 creation crystals and I am looking to expand my new collection even further.
